verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at resend.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). They also confirm markdown versions of doc pages that point agents to a full docs index at resend.com/docs/llms.txt, plus a machine-readable openapi.json. The llms.txt content itself is substantive, covering sending, batch, inbound, marketing, the CLI and MCP setup. Many docs are served as .md URLs, and a .well-known/mcp.json adds further agent-oriented discovery. missing for 10: independent/community corroboration of agents successfully using these llms.txt/markdown docs in practice.
